messages:
jamal: CI on main turned red right after merge of PR #4321 (https://git.redwood/PR/4321). failing job: gpu-smoke/kv-integration. can someone pick up?
amelia: on it, pinging owners. quick paste of failure from the job: 
```
=== RUN   TestKernelAlloc
--- FAIL: TestKernelAlloc (0.12s)
panic: runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference
.../runtime/kv_alloc.go:243 +0x98
--- FAIL
```
kevin: that stack looks like the allocator patch in PR 4321 touched kv_alloc. i'm the author of that patch. i'll look now, thanks for the ping @jamal :wave:
ci-bot: rerun triggered by @amelia (rerun-gpu-smoke #6789). queued on dedicated pool. ETA ~2m.
olivia: fyi I saw a similar flake yesterday on canary but it recovered after a rerun. could be race under heavy batching.
jamal: if it's flaky and rerun passes we can skip revert, but we need quick triage so product doesn't hit customers.
matt: for local repro, try `./scripts/run_kv_smoke.sh --seed 42 --concurrency 8` — reproduces the nil in ~1/20 on my laptop.
kevin: reproduces here with that script, looking at logs to see where nil is introduced. pushing a debug build now.
amelia: if kevin needs a bisect I can bisect using the nightly guardrail. want me to start?
kevin: please do a bisect, start at HEAD~10..HEAD and stop at PR 4321. i'll watch.
ci-bot: bisect job started by @amelia (bisect-guardrail #542). committing to snapshot: gpu-image-2026-03-17b.
jamal: thanks. also can we add a fallback in serving to avoid crash on nil pointer? quick patch is fine as hotfix.
kevin: i found the null path — allocator returns nil on OOM but caller assumed a non-nil buffer. fix incoming: add nil check + telemetry. opening PR now.
amelia: nice. bisect shows first bad commit is commit 7f9a3d8 from PR 4321.
ci-bot: rerun result: gpu-smoke #6789 — flaky, one worker failed, rerun passed.
olivia: since bisect pinned to PR4321 and kevin has a small fix, let's hotfix rather than revert. please prod a fast patch and add assertion + test.
matt: agree. i can carve a tiny test to catch this path.
kevin: PR 4330 created with fix, small and annotated: https://git.redwood/PR/4330. requesting fast-track review. cc @amelia @jamal
jamal: reviewing now. if CI green on reruns + fix lands we can close this thread. thanks all for the fast turnaround :thumbsup:
amelia: LGTM from me, landing once CI passes.
ci-bot: PR 4330 - CI checks queued.
kevin: merging on green. will follow up with postmortem note in eng-infra if we see recurrence.
jamal: please add a short blurb in #incidents if this impacts customers, otherwise postmortem in eng-infra is fine.
amelia: CI for PR 4330 passed on all smoke runs. merging.
ci-bot: merge completed by @kevin. main is green. closing triage thread.
kevin: thanks everyone for the quick help, will add test + telemetry follow-up in a separate PR.
